condition.blinded.name: Blinded
condition.blinded.rules.0: It automatically fails any ability check that requires sight.
condition.blinded.rules.1: Attack rolls against it have Advantage.
condition.charmed.name: Charmed
condition.charmed.summary: The creature sees the one who charmed it as a friend.
condition.charmed.rules.0: It can't attack the charmer or target it with damaging abilities or magical effects.
condition.charmed.rules.1: The charmer has Advantage on ability checks to interact socially with it.
condition.deafened.name: Deafened
condition.deafened.rules.0: It automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.
condition.exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
condition.exhaustion.summary: A cumulative tiredness, counted in levels from 1 to 6.
condition.exhaustion.rules.0: Each level subtracts 2 from every d20 test (attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks).
condition.exhaustion.rules.1: Each level reduces Speed by 5 feet.
condition.exhaustion.rules.3: A Long Rest removes one level.
condition.frightened.name: Frightened
condition.frightened.summary: The creature is afraid of the source of its fear.
condition.frightened.rules.0: It has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source is within line of sight.
condition.frightened.rules.1: It can't willingly move closer to the source.
condition.grappled.name: Grappled
condition.grappled.summary: Someone is holding the creature in place.
condition.grappled.rules.0: Its Speed is 0 and can’t increase.
condition.grappled.rules.1: It has Disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone other than the grappler.
condition.grappled.rules.2: The grappler can drag it along, spending extra movement.
condition.grappled.rules.3: To get free: an action and a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the escape DC.
condition.incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
condition.incapacitated.rules.0: It can't take any action, Bonus Action or Reaction.
condition.incapacitated.rules.3: If it rolls Initiative while Incapacitated, it has Disadvantage.
condition.invisible.name: Invisible
condition.invisible.rules.0: Attack rolls against it have Disadvantage, and its attack rolls have Advantage — unless the other creature can see it.
condition.invisible.rules.1: If it is Invisible when it rolls Initiative, it has Advantage on the roll.
condition.invisible.rules.2: Effects that require seeing it don’t affect it.
condition.paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
condition.paralyzed.summary: The creature can’t move a muscle.
condition.paralyzed.rules.0: It is Incapacitated and its Speed is 0.
condition.paralyzed.rules.1: It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
condition.paralyzed.rules.2: Attack rolls against it have Advantage.
condition.paralyzed.rules.3: Any attack that hits it from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit.
condition.petrified.name: Petrified
condition.petrified.summary: The creature has turned into stone (or another solid substance).
condition.petrified.rules.0: It is Incapacitated and its Speed is 0.
condition.petrified.rules.1: It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
condition.petrified.rules.2: Attack rolls against it have Advantage.
condition.petrified.rules.3: It has Resistance to all damage and Immunity to the Poisoned condition.
condition.poisoned.name: Poisoned
condition.poisoned.rules.0: It has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
condition.prone.name: Prone
condition.prone.summary: The creature is on the ground.
condition.prone.rules.0: It can only crawl, or spend half its Speed to stand up.
condition.prone.rules.2: Attack rolls against it have Advantage from within 5 feet, and Disadvantage from farther away.
condition.restrained.name: Restrained
condition.restrained.summary: Something is holding the creature fast (a net, a web, vines).
condition.restrained.rules.0: Its Speed is 0 and can’t increase.
condition.restrained.rules.1: Attack rolls against it have Advantage, and its attack rolls have Disadvantage.
condition.restrained.rules.2: It has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
condition.stunned.name: Stunned
condition.stunned.summary: The creature is dazed and can’t react.
condition.stunned.rules.1: It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
condition.stunned.rules.2: Attack rolls against it have Advantage.
condition.unconscious.name: Unconscious
condition.unconscious.summary: The creature is out cold and unaware of what happens around it.
condition.unconscious.rules.0: It is Incapacitated and Prone, and drops whatever it is holding.
condition.unconscious.rules.2: It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
condition.unconscious.rules.3: Attack rolls against it have Advantage, and any hit from within 5 feet is a Critical Hit.
action.attack.name: Attack
action.attack.summary: Make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.
action.attack.rules.0: Roll a d20, add your attack bonus, and compare it with the target’s Armor Class.
action.attack.rules.1: Some creatures and features let you make more than one attack with this action.
action.dash.name: Dash
action.dash.summary: Move twice as far this turn.
action.dash.rules.0: You gain extra movement equal to your Speed.
action.disengage.name: Disengage
action.disengage.rules.0: Your movement doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the turn.
action.dodge.name: Dodge
action.dodge.rules.0: Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage if you can see the attacker.
action.dodge.rules.1: You also have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
action.dodge.rules.2: You lose this benefit if you are Incapacitated or your Speed drops to 0.
action.help.name: Help
action.help.rules.0: Distract an enemy within 5 feet: the next attack roll an ally makes against it before your next turn has Advantage.
action.help.rules.1: Or assist an ally’s ability check: their next check with that skill or tool has Advantage.
action.hide.name: Hide
action.hide.rules.0: You need to be out of sight: heavily obscured, or behind three-quarters or total cover.
action.hide.rules.1: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check; with 15 or more you gain the Invisible condition.
action.hide.rules.2: Your check total is the DC others need to find you.
action.influence.name: Influence
action.influence.summary: Try to change a creature’s attitude.
action.influence.rules.0: Usually a Charisma check (Deception, Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion), or Wisdom (Animal Handling) with animals.
action.magic.name: Magic
action.magic.summary: Cast a spell, use a magic item, or use a magical feature.
action.magic.rules.0: Spells with a casting time of a Bonus Action or a Reaction are cast with those instead.
action.ready.name: Ready
action.ready.rules.0: Choose a trigger and an action; when the trigger happens, you can take that action with your Reaction.
action.ready.rules.1: Readying a spell needs Concentration until you release it.
action.search.name: Search
action.search.rules.0: A Wisdom check: Insight, Medicine, Perception or Survival.
action.study.name: Study
action.study.rules.0: An Intelligence check: Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature or Religion.
action.utilize.name: Utilize
action.utilize.rules.0: For example, open a door, light a torch or drink from a flask.
action.escape.name: Escape
action.escape.rules.0: A Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the escape DC; on a success you are no longer Grappled.
action.opportunity.name: Opportunity Attack
action.opportunity.summary: A free swing at someone leaving your reach.
action.opportunity.rules.0: When a creature you can see leaves your reach, you can use your Reaction to make one melee attack against it.
action.opportunity.rules.1: Disengaging, teleporting or being moved without using your own movement doesn’t provoke it.
rule.advantage.name: Advantage and Disadvantage
rule.advantage.summary: Roll two d20s: keep the higher with Advantage, the lower with Disadvantage.
rule.advantage.rules.0: If you have both, they cancel out and you roll one d20.
rule.advantage.rules.1: Several sources of Advantage still mean just two dice.
rule.d20-test.name: D20 Test
rule.d20-test.summary: The three rolls that decide success: attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks.
rule.d20-test.rules.0: Roll a d20, add the modifiers, and compare with the target number (AC or DC).
rule.ac.name: Armor Class (AC)
rule.ac.summary: How hard a creature is to hit.
rule.ac.rules.0: An attack hits if its total equals or exceeds the AC.
rule.dc.name: Difficulty Class (DC)
rule.dc.summary: The number a saving throw or ability check has to reach.
rule.dc.rules.0: Equal or higher succeeds. A spell’s DC is 8 + proficiency bonus + the spellcasting modifier.
rule.saving-throw.name: Saving Throw
rule.saving-throw.summary: A roll to resist a danger.
rule.saving-throw.rules.0: d20 + the ability modifier (+ proficiency bonus if proficient) against a DC.
rule.saving-throw.rules.1: Many effects deal half damage on a success.
rule.critical-hit.name: Critical Hit
rule.critical-hit.summary: A natural 20 on an attack roll: it always hits, and hits harder.
rule.critical-hit.rules.0: Roll the attack’s damage dice twice and add them together, then add modifiers once.
rule.concentration.name: Concentration
rule.concentration.summary: Some spells only last while the caster keeps focus.
rule.concentration.rules.0: You can concentrate on one spell at a time; casting another one ends the first.
rule.concentration.rules.1: When you take damage, make a Constitution save: DC 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher (up to 30).
rule.concentration.rules.2: It ends if you are Incapacitated or die.
rule.death-saves.name: Death Saving Throws
rule.death-saves.summary: What a character at 0 Hit Points rolls at the start of each turn.
rule.death-saves.rules.0: d20: 10 or more is a success, 9 or less a failure. Three successes: stable. Three failures: dead.
rule.death-saves.rules.1: A natural 20 brings it back with 1 Hit Point; a natural 1 counts as two failures.
rule.death-saves.rules.2: Taking damage at 0 HP is a failure (two if it is a Critical Hit).
rule.temp-hp.name: Temporary Hit Points
rule.temp-hp.summary: A buffer that absorbs damage first.
rule.temp-hp.rules.0: They don’t stack: if you get more, you choose whether to keep the old ones or take the new ones.
rule.resistance.name: Resistance, Vulnerability and Immunity
rule.resistance.summary: How a creature takes a type of damage.
rule.bonus-action.name: Bonus Action
rule.bonus-action.summary: A quick extra thing some features and spells let you do on your turn.
rule.bonus-action.rules.0: At most one per turn, and only if something gives you one.
rule.reaction.name: Reaction
rule.reaction.summary: An instant response to something that happens, even on someone else’s turn.
rule.reaction.rules.0: One per round; you get it back at the start of your turn.
rule.legendary-actions.name: Legendary Actions
rule.legendary-actions.summary: Extra actions powerful creatures take between other creatures’ turns.
rule.legendary-actions.rules.0: They are used right after another creature’s turn, and the uses come back at the start of its own turn.
rule.recharge.name: Recharge
rule.recharge.summary: A strong ability that comes back on a die roll.
rule.recharge.rules.0: “Recharge 5–6”: at the start of the creature’s turn, roll a d6; on a 5 or 6 it can use it again.
rule.bloodied.name: Bloodied
rule.bloodied.summary: A creature at half its Hit Points or fewer.
rule.bloodied.rules.0: Some abilities only work, or get stronger, while a creature is Bloodied.
rule.cover.name: Cover
rule.cover.summary: Obstacles between the attacker and the target.
rule.cover.rules.0: Half cover: +2 to AC and Dexterity saves. Three-quarters: +5.
rule.cover.rules.1: Total cover: the target can’t be targeted directly.
rule.proficiency.name: Proficiency Bonus
rule.proficiency.summary: What you add for things you are trained in.
rule.proficiency.rules.0: It goes from +2 at level 1 to +6 at level 17; for monsters, it depends on their Challenge Rating.
rule.initiative.name: Initiative
rule.initiative.summary: The order of turns in combat.
rule.initiative.rules.0: Everyone rolls a d20 + Dexterity modifier (plus any bonus); higher goes first.
ability.str.name: Strength
ability.str.rules.0: Used for melee weapon attacks (most of them), Athletics, and resisting being shoved or grappled.
ability.str.rules.1: The modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 8 is −1. Stat blocks show the modifier.
ability.dex.name: Dexterity
ability.dex.rules.0: Used for ranged and finesse attacks, Initiative, AC with light armor, and dodging area effects.
ability.dex.rules.1: The modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 8 is −1. Stat blocks show the modifier.
ability.con.name: Constitution
ability.con.rules.0: Adds to Hit Points at every level, and to saves against poison, disease and keeping Concentration.
ability.con.rules.1: The modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 8 is −1. Stat blocks show the modifier.
ability.int.name: Intelligence
ability.int.rules.0: Used for Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature and Religion; wizards cast spells with it.
ability.int.rules.1: The modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 8 is −1. Stat blocks show the modifier.
ability.wis.name: Wisdom
ability.wis.rules.0: Used for Perception, Insight, Medicine, Survival and Animal Handling, and to resist charms and fear; clerics and druids cast with it.
ability.wis.rules.1: The modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 8 is −1. Stat blocks show the modifier.
ability.cha.name: Charisma
ability.cha.summary: Confidence, poise and force of personality.
ability.cha.rules.0: Used for Deception, Intimidation, Performance and Persuasion; bards, sorcerers, warlocks and paladins cast with it.
ability.cha.rules.1: The modifier is (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down: 10 is +0, 14 is +2, 8 is −1. Stat blocks show the modifier.
skill.acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
skill.acrobatics.summary: Keeping your balance, tumbling, slipping out of a grapple.
skill.acrobatics.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.animal-handling.name: Animal Handling
skill.animal-handling.summary: Calming, reading or controlling an animal.
skill.animal-handling.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.arcana.name: Arcana
skill.arcana.summary: Knowing about magic, spells, magic items and other planes.
skill.arcana.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.athletics.name: Athletics
skill.athletics.summary: Climbing, jumping, swimming, grappling and shoving.
skill.athletics.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.deception.name: Deception
skill.deception.summary: Lying convincingly or hiding the truth.
skill.deception.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.history.name: History
skill.history.summary: Remembering events, peoples, wars and legends.
skill.history.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.insight.name: Insight
skill.insight.summary: Reading someone’s intentions and noticing a lie.
skill.insight.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.intimidation.name: Intimidation
skill.intimidation.summary: Influencing someone with threats or a hostile presence.
skill.intimidation.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.investigation.name: Investigation
skill.investigation.summary: Looking for clues and deducing from them.
skill.investigation.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.medicine.name: Medicine
skill.medicine.summary: Stabilizing a dying creature or diagnosing an illness.
skill.medicine.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.nature.name: Nature
skill.nature.summary: Knowing about terrain, plants, animals and weather.
skill.nature.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.perception.name: Perception
skill.perception.summary: Noticing things with your senses: a hidden creature, a sound, a trap.
skill.perception.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.performance.name: Performance
skill.performance.summary: Entertaining an audience with music, dance or acting.
skill.performance.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.persuasion.name: Persuasion
skill.persuasion.summary: Convincing someone with tact and good faith.
skill.persuasion.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.religion.name: Religion
skill.religion.summary: Knowing about gods, rites, holy symbols and cults.
skill.religion.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.sleight-of-hand.name: Sleight of Hand
skill.sleight-of-hand.summary: Picking a pocket, palming an object, quick hand tricks.
skill.sleight-of-hand.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.stealth.name: Stealth
skill.stealth.summary: Moving without being seen or heard; used to Hide.
skill.stealth.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
skill.survival.name: Survival
skill.survival.summary: Tracking, finding your way, foraging and predicting the weather.
skill.survival.rules.1: The bonus in a stat block already includes the ability modifier and, if trained, the proficiency bonus.
rule.action.name: Action
rule.action.summary: The main thing a creature does on its turn.
rule.action.rules.0: One per turn: attack, cast a spell, Dash, Dodge, Help, Hide… Plus moving, and a Bonus Action if something grants one.
rule.hp.name: Hit Points (HP)
rule.hp.summary: How much damage a creature can take.
rule.hp.rules.0: Damage lowers them; healing restores them, never above the maximum.
rule.hp.rules.1: At 0 HP a monster usually dies; a player character falls Unconscious and makes death saving throws.
rule.hit-dice.name: Hit Point Dice
rule.hit-dice.summary: The dice a creature’s Hit Points come from: “10 (3d6)” means 3d6, 10 on average.
rule.hit-dice.rules.0: The die depends on size: d4 Tiny, d6 Small, d8 Medium, d10 Large, d12 Huge, d20 Gargantuan.
rule.hit-dice.rules.1: Characters spend them on a Short Rest to recover HP.
rule.speed.name: Speed
rule.speed.summary: How far a creature can move on its turn.
rule.speed.rules.0: You can split it before and after your action. Dash gives you your Speed again.
rule.speed.rules.1: Fly, Swim, Climb and Burrow are speeds for moving that way; without one, climbing or swimming costs double.
rule.speed.rules.2: Grappled, Restrained, Paralyzed, Petrified and Unconscious leave it at 0; each level of Exhaustion takes 5 feet.
rule.cr.name: Challenge Rating (CR)
rule.cr.rules.0: A group of four characters of that level can usually beat one monster of that CR.
rule.cr.rules.1: It sets the monster’s proficiency bonus and the XP it gives.
rule.xp.name: Experience Points (XP)
rule.xp.summary: What defeating a monster is worth.
rule.xp.rules.0: The DM adds up the XP of an encounter to measure its difficulty and to reward the party.
rule.size.name: Size
rule.size.summary: How much space a creature takes up.
rule.size.rules.0: Tiny 2.5 ft, Small and Medium 5 ft, Large 10 ft, Huge 15 ft, Gargantuan 20 ft or more.
rule.size.rules.1: Many effects only work on creatures up to a size (“Large or smaller”).
rule.modifier.name: Modifier
rule.modifier.summary: What you add to a d20 roll.
rule.modifier.rules.0: Ability modifier: (score − 10) ÷ 2, rounded down. Proficiency adds on top when you are trained.
rule.legendary-resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
rule.legendary-resistance.summary: A few times a day, the creature can turn a failed save into a success.
rule.legendary-resistance.rules.0: The number of uses is in its name (“3/Day”). The app asks before spending one.
action.multiattack.name: Multiattack
action.multiattack.rules.0: The stat block says which attacks; each one can go to a different target.
action.multiattack.rules.1: Some let you choose (“Claw or Bite in any combination”) or replace an attack with something else.
sense.passive-perception.name: Passive Perception
sense.passive-perception.summary: What a creature notices without actively looking.
sense.passive-perception.rules.0: It is 10 + its Wisdom (Perception) bonus. Advantage adds 5, Disadvantage subtracts 5.
sense.passive-perception.rules.1: The DM compares it with a Stealth check to see whether a hidden creature is spotted.
sense.darkvision.name: Darkvision
sense.darkvision.summary: Seeing in the dark, within a range.
sense.darkvision.rules.0: Within range, dim light counts as bright light and darkness as dim light.
sense.darkvision.rules.1: In darkness it sees only in shades of gray.
sense.blindsight.name: Blindsight
sense.blindsight.summary: Perceiving its surroundings without using sight.
sense.blindsight.rules.0: Within range it knows where everything is, even in darkness, blinded, or against invisible creatures.
sense.blindsight.rules.1: Bats use echoes; oozes feel vibrations and smells.
sense.tremorsense.name: Tremorsense
sense.tremorsense.rules.0: Within range it pinpoints creatures and moving things touching the same ground or liquid.
sense.truesight.name: Truesight
sense.truesight.summary: Seeing things as they really are.
sense.truesight.rules.0: Within range it sees in normal and magical darkness, sees invisible creatures and objects, and sees through illusions.
sense.truesight.rules.1: It also sees the true form of shape-shifters and into the Ethereal Plane.
damage.acid.name: Acid
damage.acid.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.bludgeoning.name: Bludgeoning
damage.bludgeoning.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.cold.name: Cold
damage.cold.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.fire.name: Fire
damage.fire.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.force.name: Force
damage.force.summary: Pure magical energy; almost nothing resists it.
damage.force.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.lightning.name: Lightning
damage.lightning.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.necrotic.name: Necrotic
damage.necrotic.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.piercing.name: Piercing
damage.piercing.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.poison.name: Poison
damage.poison.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.psychic.name: Psychic
damage.psychic.summary: Mental attacks that rend the mind.
damage.psychic.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.radiant.name: Radiant
damage.radiant.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.slashing.name: Slashing
damage.slashing.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
damage.thunder.name: Thunder
damage.thunder.rules.0: A creature can resist it (half), be vulnerable (double) or immune (none).
ctype.aberration.name: Aberration
ctype.aberration.summary: Utterly alien beings, often with strange minds.
ctype.aberration.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.beast.name: Beast
ctype.beast.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.celestial.name: Celestial
ctype.celestial.summary: Beings from the Upper Planes, like angels.
ctype.celestial.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.construct.name: Construct
ctype.construct.summary: Made, not born: golems, animated objects.
ctype.construct.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.dragon.name: Dragon
ctype.dragon.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.elemental.name: Elemental
ctype.elemental.summary: Living air, earth, fire or water.
ctype.elemental.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.fey.name: Fey
ctype.fey.summary: Magical creatures tied to nature and the Feywild, goblins included.
ctype.fey.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.fiend.name: Fiend
ctype.fiend.summary: Demons and devils of the Lower Planes.
ctype.fiend.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.giant.name: Giant
ctype.giant.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.humanoid.name: Humanoid
ctype.humanoid.summary: People: humans, elves, dwarves, orcs and the like.
ctype.humanoid.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.monstrosity.name: Monstrosity
ctype.monstrosity.summary: Monsters that are not natural, like owlbears.
ctype.monstrosity.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.ooze.name: Ooze
ctype.ooze.summary: Gelatinous creatures with no fixed shape.
ctype.ooze.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.plant.name: Plant
ctype.plant.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
ctype.undead.name: Undead
ctype.undead.rules.0: Some spells and abilities only work on certain types (Hold Person: Humanoids).
spell.cantrip.name: Cantrip
spell.cantrip.summary: A level 0 spell, cast at will.
spell.cantrip.rules.0: It doesn’t use spell slots. Damaging cantrips get stronger at character levels 5, 11 and 17.
spell.slot.name: Spell Slot
spell.slot.summary: The “fuel” for casting a leveled spell.
spell.slot.rules.0: Casting a level 1+ spell uses a slot of that level or higher. Slots come back after a Long Rest.
spell.slot.rules.1: Using a higher slot can make the spell stronger (“Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot”).
spell.casting-time.name: Casting Time
spell.casting-time.rules.0: An action, a Bonus Action, a Reaction (with its trigger), or minutes or hours outside combat.
spell.casting-time.rules.1: On a turn you can cast only one spell that uses a slot.
spell.range.name: Range
spell.range.summary: How far away the target can be.
spell.range.rules.0: “Self”: only you (or an area starting from you). “Touch”: someone you touch.
spell.components.name: Components
spell.components.summary: What you need to cast the spell.
spell.components.rules.0: V (verbal): words of power — you must be able to speak.
spell.components.rules.1: S (somatic): gestures — you need a free hand.
spell.components.rules.2: M (material): an object or ingredient; a spellcasting focus replaces it unless it has a cost.
spell.duration.name: Duration
spell.duration.rules.0: “Instantaneous” happens and is over. Spells with “Concentration” end if you lose it.
spell.ritual.name: Ritual
spell.ritual.summary: Cast slowly, without spending a slot.
spell.ritual.rules.0: A ritual takes 10 minutes longer than the normal casting time. Not useful in the middle of a fight.
spell.attack.name: Spell Attack
spell.attack.summary: A spell that has to hit, like a weapon.
spell.attack.rules.0: d20 + spellcasting modifier + proficiency bonus, against the target’s AC.
spell.area.name: Area of Effect
spell.area.summary: A shape that affects everyone inside it.
spell.area.rules.0: Cone, Cube, Cylinder, Emanation (around the caster), Line or Sphere, each with its size.
spell.area.rules.1: Without a map, the DM decides who is inside; the app rolls once for everyone.
spell.school.name: School of Magic
spell.school.summary: The family a spell belongs to.
spell.school.rules.0: Abjuration, Conjuration, Divination, Enchantment, Evocation, Illusion, Necromancy, Transmutation. It describes the spell; it rarely changes rules.
item.magic-item.name: Magic item
item.magic-item.summary: An object with a magical property that an ordinary version does not have.
item.magic-item.rules.0: Each has a rarity, a type, and sometimes needs attunement.
item.magic-item.rules.1: You can learn an item's properties with the Identify spell, or by focusing on it through a Short Rest while touching it (that does not reveal a curse).
item.attunement.name: Attunement
item.attunement.summary: A bond with a magic item that you have to form before its magic works for you.
item.attunement.rules.0: To attune, you spend a Short Rest (1 hour) focused on the item, touching it.
item.attunement.rules.1: You can be attuned to at most 3 items at a time.
item.attunement.rules.2: Some items need a certain class or kind of creature to attune. If you stop meeting that requirement, the attunement ends.
item.attunement.rules.3: It also ends if you die, if the item stays more than 100 feet away for 24 hours, or if another creature attunes to it.
item.attunement.rules.4: Without attunement you only get the item's nonmagical benefits (a magic Shield still works as a normal Shield).
item.charges.name: Charges
item.charges.summary: A small supply of uses that the item spends, and recovers by itself.
item.charges.rules.0: Each use spends the number of charges its text says.
item.charges.rules.1: Most items regain some charges every day at dawn (the dice are in the text).
item.charges.rules.2: Some items risk being destroyed when you spend the last charge: roll a d20, and on a 1 the item crumbles.
item.curse.name: Curse
item.curse.summary: A hidden drawback: the item looks like a boon but works against its owner.
item.curse.rules.0: The curse usually shows up only when you attune, or when Identify reveals it.
item.curse.rules.1: You cannot end the attunement of a cursed item until the curse is broken (Remove Curse or similar magic).
item.bonus.name: +N bonus
item.bonus.summary: A flat number added to attacks and damage (weapons) or to AC (armor).
item.bonus.rules.0: The rarity sets the number: Uncommon +1, Rare +2, Very Rare +3.
item.bonus.rules.1: On a weapon it adds to the attack roll and to the damage roll. On armor or a Shield it adds to Armor Class.
item.base.name: Base weapon or armor
item.base.summary: The ordinary weapon or armor that the magic item is built on.
item.base.rules.0: The same magic item can be built on many bases (a +1 weapon exists for every weapon): the text is the same, only the base changes.
item.base.rules.1: The base gives the damage dice, the properties and the mastery (weapons), or the AC and requirements (armor).
item.variants.name: Variants
item.variants.summary: The same item with a different base weapon or armor.
item.variants.rules.0: All the variants share the same text and rules.
item.rarity.common.name: Common
item.rarity.common.summary: The easiest magic item to find, and the weakest.
item.rarity.common.rules.0: Rarity is a rough guide to how powerful an item is and how hard it is to come by.
item.rarity.common.rules.1: Common items are rare in the books too: this scale only helps the DM place treasure.
item.rarity.uncommon.name: Uncommon
item.rarity.uncommon.summary: Useful, but not strong enough to change a fight on its own.
item.rarity.uncommon.rules.0: Weapons and armor of this rarity give a +1 bonus.
item.rarity.uncommon.rules.1: Found by characters of low level.
item.rarity.rare.name: Rare
item.rarity.rare.summary: A strong item that a party usually finds a few levels in.
item.rarity.rare.rules.0: Weapons and armor of this rarity give a +2 bonus.
item.rarity.veryRare.name: Very Rare
item.rarity.veryRare.summary: A powerful item for characters well into their adventuring career.
item.rarity.veryRare.rules.0: Weapons and armor of this rarity give a +3 bonus.
item.rarity.legendary.name: Legendary
item.rarity.legendary.summary: An item that characters might build a whole story around.
item.rarity.legendary.rules.0: Very few exist; each is usually unique and has a name that people know.
item.rarity.artifact.name: Artifact
item.rarity.artifact.summary: A one-of-a-kind item of enormous power, outside the normal rarity scale.
item.rarity.artifact.rules.0: The DM decides whether the party ever holds one, and how to take it away.
item.cat.weapon.name: Magic weapon
item.cat.weapon.summary: A weapon with a magical property on top of what it normally does.
item.cat.weapon.rules.0: Most are an ordinary weapon (the base weapon) made magical; the base decides the damage and properties.
item.cat.weapon.rules.1: A magic weapon counts as magical for getting past Resistance to nonmagical attacks.
item.cat.armor.name: Magic armor
item.cat.armor.summary: Armor or a Shield with a magical property.
item.cat.armor.rules.0: The base armor decides the AC, the Dexterity limit and the Strength requirement.
item.cat.wondrous.name: Wondrous item
item.cat.wondrous.summary: Anything magical that is not a weapon, armor, potion, ring, rod, staff or wand.
item.cat.wondrous.rules.0: Cloaks, boots, bags, gems, instruments… The catch-all category, and the biggest.
item.cat.potion.name: Potion
item.cat.potion.summary: A magic liquid that works once, when you drink it.
item.cat.potion.rules.0: Drinking a potion, or giving it to another creature, takes a Bonus Action. An oil can take longer: its text says.
item.cat.ring.name: Ring
item.cat.ring.summary: A magic ring, worn on a finger.
item.cat.ring.rules.0: Most rings need attunement, and attunement is limited to 3 items.
item.cat.rod.name: Rod
item.cat.rod.summary: A magic rod, held in the hand to use its power.
item.cat.rod.rules.0: Unless its text says otherwise, it can be used as an arcane focus. Many rods have charges.
item.cat.staff.name: Staff
item.cat.staff.summary: A magic staff, usually also a fine Quarterstaff.
item.cat.staff.rules.0: Unless its text says otherwise, it can be used as a nonmagical staff and as an arcane focus. Most hold charges that cast spells.
item.cat.wand.name: Wand
item.cat.wand.summary: A short magic wand, held in the hand to use its power.
item.cat.wand.rules.0: Unless its text says otherwise, it can be used as an arcane focus. Most hold charges and cast a spell when you spend them.
weapon.ammunition.name: Ammunition
weapon.ammunition.summary: A ranged weapon that needs a piece of ammunition for each attack.
weapon.ammunition.rules.0: Each attack uses one piece. After the fight you can spend 1 minute to recover half of what you used (rounded down). A magic weapon's ammunition counts as magical.
weapon.ammunition.rules.1: The two numbers are the normal and the long range, in feet.
weapon.finesse.name: Finesse
weapon.finesse.summary: You may use Strength or Dexterity for the attack and the damage.
weapon.finesse.rules.0: You pick one and use the same ability for both rolls.
weapon.heavy.name: Heavy
weapon.heavy.summary: A weapon that needs strength to handle well.
weapon.heavy.rules.0: You need Strength 13 (Dexterity 13 if it is ranged) or you have Disadvantage on its attacks.
weapon.light.name: Light
weapon.light.summary: Small enough to fight with one in each hand.
weapon.light.rules.0: When you attack with a Light weapon in your turn, you can make an extra attack as a Bonus Action with another Light weapon. You do not add your ability modifier to that damage unless it is negative.
weapon.loading.name: Loading
weapon.loading.summary: You can fire only one piece of ammunition with it per action.
weapon.loading.rules.0: It does not matter how many attacks you could make: one shot per action, bonus action or reaction.
weapon.reach.name: Reach
weapon.reach.summary: It adds 5 feet to your reach with the weapon.
weapon.reach.rules.0: It also adds 5 feet to the range of opportunity attacks you make with it.
weapon.thrown.name: Thrown
weapon.thrown.summary: You can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack.
weapon.thrown.rules.0: You can draw it as part of the attack, and use the same ability modifier as for a melee attack with it.
weapon.thrown.rules.1: The two numbers are the normal and the long range, in feet.
weapon.two-handed.name: Two-Handed
weapon.two-handed.summary: You need two hands to attack with it.
weapon.two-handed.rules.0: A note on the weapon can lift the requirement in a special case (for example, while mounted).
weapon.versatile.name: Versatile
weapon.versatile.summary: You can hold it in one hand or two.
weapon.versatile.rules.0: Held in two hands for a melee attack, it uses the bigger damage die shown next to the property.
weapon.simple.name: Simple weapon
weapon.simple.summary: A weapon almost anyone is trained with.
weapon.simple.rules.0: Most characters are proficient with Simple weapons.
weapon.martial.name: Martial weapon
weapon.martial.summary: A weapon that takes real combat training.
weapon.martial.rules.0: Only fighters and a few other classes are proficient with Martial weapons. Without proficiency you do not add your Proficiency Bonus to the attack.
weapon.range.name: Range
weapon.range.summary: Two numbers: how far a ranged weapon shoots normally, and how far at most.
weapon.range.rules.0: Past the normal range you attack with Disadvantage; past the long range you cannot attack.
mastery.cleave.name: Cleave
mastery.cleave.summary: A hit can carry through to a second enemy.
mastery.cleave.rules.0: After hitting with a melee attack, you can attack a second creature within 5 feet of the first. You do not add your ability modifier to that damage. Once per turn.
mastery.graze.name: Graze
mastery.graze.summary: A miss still hurts a little.
mastery.graze.rules.0: If your attack misses, the target still takes damage equal to the ability modifier you attacked with (the damage type of the weapon).
mastery.nick.name: Nick
mastery.nick.summary: The extra Light attack costs no Bonus Action.
mastery.nick.rules.0: The extra attack from the Light property is made as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. Once per turn.
mastery.push.name: Push
mastery.push.summary: A hit shoves the target back.
mastery.push.rules.0: On a hit you can push a Large or smaller target up to 10 feet straight away from you.
mastery.sap.name: Sap
mastery.sap.summary: A hit leaves the target off balance.
mastery.sap.rules.0: On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
mastery.slow.name: Slow
mastery.slow.summary: A hit slows the target down.
mastery.slow.rules.0: On a hit that deals damage, the target loses 10 feet of Speed until the start of your next turn. Penalties from several hits do not stack.
mastery.topple.name: Topple
mastery.topple.summary: A hit can knock the target down.
mastery.topple.rules.0: On a hit, the target makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + the ability modifier you attacked with + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failure it has the Prone condition.
mastery.vex.name: Vex
mastery.vex.summary: A hit gives you the upper hand on the next attack.
mastery.vex.rules.0: On a hit that deals damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that target before the end of your next turn.
armor.light.name: Light armor
armor.light.summary: Armor that adds your full Dexterity modifier to its AC.
armor.light.rules.0: Putting it on or taking it off takes 1 minute. Without training you have Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity d20 tests and cannot cast spells.
armor.medium.name: Medium armor
armor.medium.summary: Armor that adds your Dexterity modifier to its AC, up to +2.
armor.medium.rules.0: Putting it on takes 5 minutes and taking it off takes 1 minute. It needs training, like all armor.
armor.heavy.name: Heavy armor
armor.heavy.summary: Armor with a fixed AC: your Dexterity does not change it.
armor.heavy.rules.0: Putting it on takes 10 minutes and taking it off takes 5 minutes. Some need a minimum Strength.
armor.shield.name: Shield
armor.shield.summary: Held in one hand; it adds a flat number to your AC.
armor.shield.rules.0: You can benefit from only one Shield at a time, and only the AC bonus if you are trained with Shields. Donning or doffing it takes a Utilize action.
armor.stealth-disadvantage.name: Stealth Disadvantage
armor.stealth-disadvantage.summary: Wearing this armor gives you Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
armor.stealth-disadvantage.rules.0: The noise or bulk of the armor gives you away.
armor.strength.name: Strength requirement
armor.strength.summary: A minimum Strength to wear the armor without penalty.
armor.strength.rules.0: If your Strength is lower, your Speed drops by 10 feet while you wear it.
